full_judgment: 18. Even the provisions of section 51 does not say that the award passed under section 50 of the Act or the decision given under section 51 will be deemed to be a decree of a civil court, so that it could have any binding effect upon the Sub-Registrar or could have been enforced by filing an execution case. Therefore, the jurisdiction of the civil court is not ousted by section 50 of the Act, at least in the instant case and so far as the reliefs claimed in the instant suit is concerned.
